The stretch between pos 1 and pos 2 (A x~1250-1400) is damaged with only a faint upright; recorded as [...]. The separate left piece of A (x~30-240) is displaced ~half a line: its letters nearest the marked height (ב, ח at y~36-120) correspond in B strip 1 to the line ABOVE; the line below them (y~136-208) has faint traces (an upright at x~37-57, a diagonal + base at x~92-157, crossed by a long scratch) that I cannot read, and I have not included them in the transcription. Space (blank surface with casting pits) between pos 3 and pos 4 (A x~1170-1290). A long base line under pos 12-13 runs continuously; the division there is uncertain. The object appears to be the Copper Scroll from Qumran (engraved copper, electrotype copy, X-rayed strips), but I do not recall the text of this line and have reported only what the images show.
